title: The relationship and difference between state and government
competency: Explain how state and government are related and how they differ.

keywords.def: An abstract entity with four elements: population, territory, government and sovereignty.
The people, institutions and rules that run a state at a given time; the "brain of the state".

en.text: Government is one of the four elements of a state (population, territory, government, sovereignty) and its "brain": no state can exist without one. But they differ: the state is wider, abstract, extrinsic and almost permanent; government is narrower, concrete, intrinsic to human society and temporary, changing over time.

am.text: መንግሥት ከሀገረ መንግሥቱ አራት አካላት አንዱና "አንጎሉ" ነው። ሀገረ መንግሥቱ ሰፊ፣ ረቂቅና ዘላቂ ሲሆን መንግሥት ጠባብ፣ ተጨባጭና ጊዜያዊ ነው።

screens.title: Many governments, one state
screens.ask: Ethiopia has had many different governments over the centuries. Has Ethiopia, the state, remained?
opts: Yes: governments change, the state lasts
No, a new state each time
screens.after: Governments come and go; the state is almost permanent.

screens.title: How they are related
paras: A state cannot exist without a government.
The Montevideo Convention lists four elements of a state: population, territory, government, sovereignty.
Government carries out the state's goals: it is the "brain of the state".
The state gives legitimacy to the government; the government makes the state real.

screens.title: How they differ
paras: They are closely related but different.
table: Extrinsic: people can live without a state

screens.text: Which statements about state and government are true?
pool: The state gives legitimacy to government
Government is the brain of the state
A state cannot exist without government
The state is intrinsic, government extrinsic
a: The state gives legitimacy to government
Government is the brain of the state
A state cannot exist without government
screens.why: The last one is reversed: government is intrinsic, the state extrinsic.
screens.clue: Check the direction of the last one.
